name: Kar Parts Direct Co Aftermarket Auto Body Parts
old_description: Your one-stop shop for all your CAPA and Aftermarket replacement auto body parts. Serving the Greater Los Angeles area for over 15+ Years!
about:
Kar Parts Direct Co operates from Gardena, California, with a second location in North Hollywood and a corporate headquarters in Carson. The company was founded in 2011 and has served the Greater Los Angeles area for over a decade, supplying collision repair shops and auto body businesses with aftermarket replacement parts. Ownership details and founder names are not publicly disclosed.

The distributor stocks more than 20,000 SKUs of CAPA-certified and aftermarket auto body parts, including bumpers, fenders, hoods, headlights, and radiators. Its two facilities provide will-call and delivery services, with a dispatch team focused on just-in-time delivery to customers across Los Angeles County. Quality benchmarks cited include Vehicle Data Information (VDI), FMVSS-108 photometry durability testing, and Vehicle Test Fit (VTF) protocols.

Primary customers are independent collision repair centers, dealership body shops, and wholesale buyers in the Greater Los Angeles region. The company serves the automotive aftermarket and collision repair industries, offering parts that fit popular vehicle applications without additional modification costs.

Kar Parts Direct emphasizes competitive pricing, fast turnaround, and an experienced customer service team as its core differentiators. The business highlights its ISO 9001 certification and CAPA-certified inventory as evidence of its commitment to reliable fit and durability.
